pick.headline: Panama votes; Noriega's regime moves to annul the result
pick.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of May 9, 1989, shows only a contents line under Venezuela: Madrid EFE citing President Perez on the Panamanian and Bolivian elections.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Latin America, No. 088, 9 May 1989
evidence.snippet: …T-89-088 09 May 1989 Garcia on INE ‘Manipulation,’ Brazil Ties /Lima TV] Deputy’s Murder Prompts Garcia's Early Return /Madrid EFE] ‘Thousands’ Detained in Case /Madrid EFE] Venezuela Perez Cited on Panamanian, Bolivian Elections /Madrid EFE] Defense Minister Explains U.S. Airplanes /Caracas TV]
